fields.description: Issue includes an editorial/feature criticizing gambling interests in Greater Miami and alleging clandestine gambling at the Miami Beach and Tennis Club under owner Mert Wertheimer; discussion of racing economics and calls to limit racing hours; coverage of a police brutality controversy involving Officer G. A. Denny and the beating of 17-year-old George C. Kirkland, Jr.; local columns and nightlife listings; campus and society chatter; sports talk and racing tips/advertisements (including "Jockey Jimmy" selections) tied to Tropical Park and other tracks; and notes on a proposed federal housing project for Black residents in Miami.
